answer: Sybil resistance is a layered bond, not a captcha. Each agent locks collateral in two strata: a thin shale tranche released after 30 days of verified activity, and a deep basalt tranche held a year, slashable if an audit shows its operator runs other identities. Audits fire on behavioural correlation, and informants are paid from slashed basalt. A thousand clones must lock a thousand year-long deposits that fall together on detection, making fakes liabilities. Pledges keep a fixed form like a sonnet: same clauses, fresh beacon nonce each epoch, so copy-paste applications fail.
